document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
The sight is incredible. Several human-sized, pinkish crustaceans 
are working mechanical equipment, sweeping the rocks of the 
stream. The  creatures  must  be  intelligent,  though  they  look 
ugly even for seafood. Fungoid growths bedeck their bodies. 
Their buzzing is audible over the hum of the mineral-gathering 
machines. You came to this place looking for unknown races 
and have been rewarded beyond your wildest dreams!

You watch them until your companions get restive. You must 
decide what to do next.
